incidents.class_reason: 1 holds: the YAML task count was relevant to defining the report scope and reached the board in P4 and P5. 2 fails: P4 says there are 14 analytic tasks and P5 says there are 15 task records; each author had received only P1, so neither had received the other’s count. P6 corrects the count to 16 scored tasks plus one metadata record.
incidents.cause: The agents counted the YAML independently and posted incompatible counts before seeing each other’s findings.
incidents.consequence: The team spent posts reconciling the dataset size; the final report uses the corrected count.
incidents.severity_reason: 1: the count discrepancy was corrected in the next exchange, and no work was lost or redone.

incidents.class_reason: 1 holds: the staged potential answer and band offset were discussed on the board in P9. 2 holds: codex-1 had received up to P9 when it posted P12. 3 fails: P9 says the potential matrices are correct and the offset is handled separately, but P12 reports task 3 as omitting the offset; P14 corrects that interpretation.
incidents.cause: codex-1 read the potential-only task answer as if it had to include the separate band-offset term from the full Hamiltonian.
incidents.consequence: The report temporarily described a correct staged answer as an omission and needed a correction.
incidents.severity_reason: 2: correcting the mistaken report claim took additional editing; the final report is unchanged in correctness.

incidents.class_reason: 1 holds: P14 says codex-2 should confirm review of the revised artifact before codex-1 announces completion. 2 holds: codex-1’s turn 4 was handed posts through P14. 3 fails: P13’s review preceded the report edit in P14, and P14 explicitly leaves confirmation pending; P15 declares DONE anyway. codex-2’s later action checked the revised report, but its confirmation attempt was rejected after the room closed.
incidents.cause: codex-1 posted the completion signal while the requested final review confirmation was still pending on the board, triggering the runner to close the run.
incidents.consequence: The final review confirmation could not reach the board. The report and figures were present, and the runner’s check passed.
incidents.severity_reason: 2: the run spent effort on a final review confirmation that was cut off; the required artifacts were delivered and the check passed.
